title: A2v10 metadata.json (endpoint)
description: One endpoint: catalog, document, journal, or an operation of a document. A report, the autonum registry, an enum set, a chart of accounts and a ledger have schemas of their own. Enum values are written in camelCase as listed; command tokens are PascalCase and case-sensitive.

description.description: Read by the model only, never by the platform: the rules of this endpoint and their reasons.

table.description: The table this endpoint owns. No default.

storage.description: Path of the endpoint that declares the table this one writes into. Document, catalog and journal only. One hop: the target must declare 'table'.

schema.description: Defaults to the folder the endpoint lives in.

model.description: Stem of the generated names. Defaults to the endpoint folder name in PascalCase.

presentation.description: The column a record is shown by where it is referenced. Not written: the Name column, else the autonum one; neither is refused at load.

printForms.description: Print blanks, one entry per blank, in menu order. Non-empty puts the Print command on the default toolbars. Not inherited from 'storage'.

fixed.description: Field -> value this endpoint fixes: its rows carry these values and a new record starts on them. Written in the column's JSON type. A field may not also be in 'initialValues'. Not inherited from 'storage'.

post.description: What posting does. With 'operations' it is not written here: each operation posts in its own way, in its own file.

basedOn.description: Documents that may be created from this one, in the order of the 'create on basis' menu; each target once. Of the document, never of an operation. Not inherited from 'storage'.

operations.description: Document only, never on the storage. Operation names in selector order; the first is where a new document starts. Each name is a file '<name>.operation.json' beside this one (metadata-operation-json-schema.json), and every such file is listed here; both checked at load. Requires a field of type 'operation' in the shape; 'post' is then written in the operation files, and 'initialValues' may not name that field.

autonum.description: Key of autonum/metadata.json this endpoint numbers from. Refused at load if that file does not declare it, or if the shape has no column of type 'autonum'. An operation without its own draws from the storage's.

fields.description: Column name -> column. The key is the name; there is no 'name' inside.

target.description: For a reference: path of the endpoint it points at, e.g. '/catalog/item'. Required, and checked against the kind, for 'enum' ('/enum/...'), 'state' ('/state/...'), 'account' ('/accplan/...'), 'company' ('/catalog/company') and 'basedOn' ('/document/...'). At most one 'company' column per table, none in a collection.

origin.description: Name of this table, column or value in the system it was carried over from. Written by the model; the platform ignores it.

details.description: Collection key -> the rows of that collection. The key is what the generated side composes names from.

detail.description: A child table. Its schema is the owner's and its name is composed as <owner model><collection key>, so neither is declared here.

kinds.description: Row kind key -> what that kind declares. The keys are the value set of the discriminator column; the value carries rules and nothing else.

value.description: For 'Literal' - the scalar itself, in the JSON type of the receiving domain. For every other source - a name or an expression, so a string.

rules.description: The key is the KIND of rule; field names live inside it. Each kind carries its own shape.

conditionalRules.description: The same rule kinds under a condition. Depth is exactly 1 - there is no 'when' here.

expressions.description: Field -> JavaScript expression, written in full with 'this.'.

inherits.description: Receiving field -> where the value is taken from when the reference changes.

ref.description: A Ref field in the same set of fields as the receiver.

field.description: A field of the endpoint the reference targets. One hop - chains are not expressible.

postLedger.description: Posting into a ledger: two mirrored legs. CorrAcc, InOut, Date and the provenance are filled by the platform, never mapped. A leg with no 'row' block is collapsed to the header.

ledger.description: Path of the ledger endpoint, e.g. '/ledger/national'.

sum.description: The sum field: of the iterated row under 'each', else of the header. One for both legs.

postLeg.description: One leg: ledger column -> its source, the source being the block key. Keys are 'Acc' or the author's columns of the ledger, never the provenance; a column in one block only; exactly one 'Acc' across the blocks.

const.description: Ledger column -> literal. An account literal is a code of the chart's seed file, checked at load.

document.description: Ledger column -> field of the document header. Domain and target must match.

row.description: Ledger column -> field of the iterated row. Requires 'each'.

postSql.description: Posting by a stored procedure. The only entry of 'post'.

sql.description: The procedures. Called with @Id and @UserId inside a transaction they do not own: no commit or rollback, fail by throwing.

unpost.description: Not written: the posted rows are deleted by provenance.

journals.description: Every journal the procedure writes into.

journal.description: Path of the journal endpoint, e.g. '/journal/stock'.

each.description: The collection this posting iterates, and which of its kinds. 'kinds' is required when the collection declares kinds.

document.description: Journal field -> field of the document header.

row.description: Journal field -> field of the iterated row.

target.description: Path of the document created, e.g. '/document/waybillout'. Its header needs exactly one field of type 'basedOn' targeting this document: the basis is written there.

operation.description: The operation of the target, by the name its 'operations' lists. Written exactly when the target lists operations.

document.description: Deviations only: field of the target header -> field of this header. The rest is copied by name and domain.

each.description: Copy rows: the target's collection and its kinds; rows come from the collection of the same name here. Without it only the header is copied.

formSet.description: The keys are closed: index, browse, edit. A declared form replaces the default entirely. Per endpoint, not inherited from 'storage'.

listForm.description: 'index': the page over the collection; 'browse': the pick dialog. No root kind: the action decides.

editForm.description: The record's form: a page or a dialog, by 'is'.
editForm.$comment: 'is' is required rather than defaulted: FormKind.Unknown is C#'s zero, 'not written', and EditDialogXaml throws on it - so a form leaving it out fails at the first render, not at the load.

allOf.$comment: DeclarationBake: "form 'edit': 'toolbar' declared on a dialog, which has no command bar." Refused here on the key, where the load refuses it on a non-empty 'commands'.

formNode.description: A form element outside a tab strip: anything but a tab.

formTab.description: A strip shows tabs and nothing else.

scope.description: The collection this node is anchored to.

kind.description: One kind of that collection. Required together with 'scope' exactly when the collection declares kinds.

filters.description: Names of the endpoint's filters, not fields. An unknown name is refused at load.

formElement.$comment: The branches below are a second reading of FormElement.ContentKeys and CheckElement and of nothing else: what each kind's render reads, and where it may stand. Refused here in the editor, one step before the load refuses the same thing. 'axis'/'labelAt' are refused off a group as well - only CreateGroupPanel reads them, and a schema, unlike the loader, can tell a written enum from an absent one. 'tab' keeps its list keys: the platform has not described what else a tab may carry, and a schema is not the place to decide it - but a tab inside a tab is placement, which is decided (CheckElement: 'a tab is drawn only by its strip'), so a tab's 'elements' take the same node as a body's. An empty strip is refused for the same reason the load refuses it (StripState: 'tabs: no tab declared'). 'is' is required and never defaulted: FormElementKind.Group is C#'s zero, so a node that leaves it out becomes a group in silence, and this file is the only place that can tell an absent key from a written one.

commandBarItem.description: A command name or a bar token. Case-sensitive.

mcp.description: What the model is told about this address beyond what derives. Only on an endpoint listed in mcp.json. Per address, not inherited from 'storage'.

description.description: Shown by domain_info when the folder name is not enough.

searchBy.description: Catalog only. Field -> how catalog_find matches it: 'exact' (=) or 'contains' (substring). Written, it replaces the derived set whole (the presentation as 'contains', a 'unique' string field as 'exact').

path.description: Path of the blank file, relative to the endpoint folder, without extension ('.json' is appended). The last segment is the blank's name; two blanks under one name are refused.

title.description: Caption of the menu item that prints it. Localizable: '@[...]'.

header.description: Title of the viewer window, a template over the record: 'Waybill No {Document.Number} of {Document.Date}'. A path starts with the model name and goes through references only: no collection, and the model name alone is refused. Not written: 'title'. Not the blank's own heading.

enumDescriptions: A layout panel: the editors it carries ('fields') and the groups under it ('elements'). The only kind that reads 'axis' and 'labelAt'.
A tab strip. Holds tabs and nothing else; the tabs of one strip are different row sets.
One row set inside a strip: 'scope' names the collection, 'kind' one of its kinds. Drawn only by its strip.
A grid over the collection this form is scoped to. Shows 'fields'.
A tree over the collection this form is scoped to, read whole. Shows 'fields'.
A command bar. Holds 'commands' - the author's own; the standard bar is the template's and no form declares it.
The pager of the grid. Shows nothing of its own.
The filter panel. 'filters' are references into the endpoint's filter namespace, not fields.

columnType.description: What the column stores. Not written: string. NULL follows the type: amount, qty, price, percent, factor, money, decimal, float and boolean are NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, the rest nullable. No 'default' or 'notNull' key: a new record starts from 'initialValues'.
